# MONTREAL.AI

MONTREAL.AI is the permanent founder-controlled parent institution of GoalOS, AGI.eth, ASI.eth, AGI Club, AGI Alpha and a federation of project-specific intelligence Maisons.

Canonical public entry points:
- English: https://montrealai.github.io/
- Français: https://montrealai.github.io/fr/
- ASI.ETH Machine Civilization Root: https://montrealai.github.io/asi/
- MCAP-001 Root Manifest: https://montrealai.github.io/asi/manifest.json
- Machine Civilization Addressability Protocol: https://montrealai.github.io/asi/MCAP-001.md
- Successor Covenant Ω: https://montrealai.github.io/asi/COVENANT.md
- Namespace and succession registry: https://montrealai.github.io/asi/registry.json
- Agent context: https://montrealai.github.io/asi/agent-context.json
- Public repository: https://github.com/MontrealAI/MontrealAI.github.io

ASI.ETH doctrine:
- ASI.ETH is the addressable root of a proof-gated Machine Civilization architecture.
- A successor is an institutionally qualified continuation, not merely a copied agent or newer model.
- Memory may cross; authority must requalify.
- Capability may compound; trust must be earned anew.
- Namespace resolution provides discovery and identity; it does not itself prove capability, safety, legitimacy or authority.
- Proposed ENS roles are not active until owner-signed transactions and resolved-record evidence are published.

Core MONTREAL.AI doctrine:
- AI creates candidate output; GoalOS creates proof-governed missions.
- Execute, Validate, Accept, Admit and Settle are distinct acts.
- Public proof; private capability; governed authority.
- No model response, cryptographic commitment or browser demonstration independently proves an off-chain fact.
- Only validated, scoped, rights-cleared and revocable capability may enter institutional memory.

Claims boundary:
The public site does not claim achieved AGI or ASI, guaranteed returns, legal certification, external validation, customer acceptance or realized outcomes unless a specific public record supports that claim.
